M-FOCUS-MANAGER.Purpose: Adapter over the string-based native IMGUI focus system: assign each focusable widget instance a stable engine-scoped control name, forward focus requests, and resolve the focused widget for keyboard event dispatch.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: FocusManager: per-WidgetEngine bidirectional Widget <-> controlName registry.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: Stable controlName assignment of the form "FV:{engine.Key}:{sequence}", invariant to layout changes.
Scope.SCP-IN-003: Focus resolution: GUI.GetNameOfFocusedControl lookup restricted to this engine's name prefix.
Scope.SCP-IN-004: Per-frame liveness pruning: widgets not rendered in a frame lose registration and native focus.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Keyboard event dispatch — owned by M-FLEX-EVENTS.
Scope.SCP-OUT-002: Native text editing inside GUI.TextField — owned by the widget.

Requirements.REQ-001: Control names are assigned once per mounted instance and remain stable across frames and layout changes.
Requirements.REQ-002: GetFocusedWidget returns null when the native focus belongs to another engine, an unregistered control, or nothing.
Requirements.REQ-003: Unregistering a natively focused widget releases the native focus via GUI.FocusControl(null).
Requirements.REQ-004: A widget not registered during the current render frame (including unmounted or unrendered subtrees) is unregistered at frame end.

Inputs.IN-001: widget: Widget — focusable instance registering itself during OnGUI.

Outputs.OUT-001: Register returns the stable controlName for GUI.SetNextControlName.
Outputs.OUT-002: GetFocusedWidget returns the focused Widget or null.

SideEffects.EFF-002: Unregister of a focused widget issues GUI.FocusControl(null).
